serviceCapacity.source: allocatedMin from flexcar.service_capacities; bookedMin from each bucket's own table (capacity_bookings Order / maintenance_bookings / unassigned_services); service_capacities reserved columns carried as ledgerBookedMin only
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin = modelled service minutes set aside for the bucket; bookedMin = authoritative booked minutes from the bucket's own table; ledgerBookedMin = the service_capacities reserved figure, which lags intermittently and is kept only so the divergence stays visible; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy; null means no service_capacities row for that site/day, not zero capacity

orderCapacity.note: static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series - the same ceiling applies to every day of the window; daily_order_capacity is the admin UI's 'Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity' (pickup+swap only, not all orders); null means not configured, which is not the same as a ceiling of 0
